title: CreativeIntentV1
description: S12: user creative intent for F1/MCP prompt optimize / revise. Semantics are carried by closed enums and structured proposedChanges — hosts must not grep free-text goal/notes for policy. applyPolicy is the only switch that decides auto-apply vs preview.

applyPolicy.description: previewOnly = never write; applyWhenNoBlocking = write only when review has zero blocking findings; applyDirect = write without waiting for a review round (still subject to revision CAS).

changeOp.description: Structural edit op. Hosts apply by fieldId, never by searching goal text.

value.description: Required for set/append; forbidden for clear. Full text, never truncated.

goal.description: Human goal text for the model. Hosts must not parse it for apply/rewrite policy.

sourceRefs.description: Closed set of sources the model may cite. Empty = none; hosts never invent sources from navigation.

proposedChanges.description: May be empty on clarifyThenPropose. Each change targets one field on one resource.

contextPackRef.description: Opaque id of a CreativeContextPack page/summary the intent was built from.
